decisions.reason: Choosing ERC-721C and whitelisting secondary marketplaces does not change which NFT-associated entitlements and state transfer to a resale buyer.
The token-standard choice does not change the collection's unlimited-mint NFT ebook model; the standard is already recorded by the source Requirement.
The royalty-enforcement standard and marketplace whitelist do not alter any current metadata field, counter, referral-code source, or book-access link.
The existing FAQ statement that secondary sales carry a flat $10 royalty remains accurate; the source does not require the FAQ to disclose ERC-721C or marketplace whitelisting.
The enforcement mechanism for the $10 royalty does not change the Small Block prize amount, draw cadence, ticket window, or existing rule that secondary-sale proceeds fund the pool.
The source confirms a smart-contract royalty mechanism but does not direct any change to the About page's technology, process, feature, or vision copy.
Marketplace whitelisting and royalty enforcement do not affect automatic prize delivery or any prize-claim interaction.
The source changes secondary-market royalty enforcement, while referral prize tickets remain issued only for qualifying primary mints and not for secondary sales.
The ERC-721C and marketplace-whitelist decision does not change badge triggers, milestones, or on-chain badge recording.
The collection remains deployed on Base; selecting ERC-721C instead of standard ERC-721 does not change the required blockchain or network class.
The royalty-enforcement implementation choice has no effect on the deferred Discord community and support server.
The source preserves the flat $10 secondary royalty and does not change the $15 primary mint price or primary-sale revenue allocation.
